BINARY-SEARCH(A, p, r, x)
    if p > r then
        return -1
    q ← (p + r) div 2
    if A[q] = x then
        return q
    else if A[q] > x then
        return BINARY-SEARCH(A, p, q - 1, x)
    else
        return BINARY-SEARCH(A, q + 1, r, x)

ITERATIVE-BINARY-SEARCH(A, n, x)
    low ← 1
    high ← n
    while low ≤ high do
        mid ← (low + high) div 2
        if A[mid] = x then
            return mid
        else if A[mid] < x then
            low ← mid + 1
        else
            high ← mid - 1
    return -1

HALVING(n)

POWER(x, n)
    if n = 0 then
        return 1
    if n mod 2 = 0 then
        half ← POWER(x, n div 2)
        return half * half
    else
        return x * POWER(x, n - 1)

FIND-FLOOR(A, n, x)
    low ← 1
    high ← n
    result ← -1
    while low ≤ high do
        mid ← (low + high) div 2
        if A[mid] ≤ x then
            result ← mid
            low ← mid + 1
        else
            high ← mid - 1
    return result

FIND-CEIL(A, n, x)
    low ← 1
    high ← n
    result ← -1
    while low ≤ high do
        mid ← (low + high) div 2
        if A[mid] ≥ x then
            result ← mid
            high ← mid - 1
        else
            low ← mid + 1
    return result

LINEAR-SEARCH(A, n, x)

FIND-MAX(A, n)

FIND-MIN(A, n)

SUM-ARRAY(A, n)

COUNT-ELEMENT(A, n, x)

REVERSE-ARRAY(A, n)

FACTORIAL-ITERATIVE(n)

MERGE-SORT(A, p, r)
    if p < r then
        q ← (p + r) div 2
        MERGE-SORT(A, p, q)
        MERGE-SORT(A, q + 1, r)
        MERGE(A, p, q, r)

QUICKSORT(A, p, r)

        q ← PARTITION(A, p, r)
        QUICKSORT(A, p, q - 1)
        QUICKSORT(A, q + 1, r)

HEAP-SORT(A, n)

        temp ← A[1]
        A[1] ← A[i]
        A[i] ← temp
        MAX-HEAPIFY(A, 1, i - 1)

PARTITION(A, p, r)
    x ← A[r]
    i ← p - 1
    for j ← p to r - 1 do
        if A[j] ≤ x then
            i ← i + 1
            temp ← A[i]
            A[i] ← A[j]
            A[j] ← temp
    temp ← A[i + 1]
    A[i + 1] ← A[r]
    A[r] ← temp
    return i + 1

MERGE(A, p, q, r)
    n1 ← q - p + 1
    n2 ← r - q
    for i ← 1 to n1 do
        L[i] ← A[p + i - 1]
    for j ← 1 to n2 do
        R[j] ← A[q + j]
    i ← 1
    j ← 1
    for k ← p to r do
        if L[i] ≤ R[j] then
            A[k] ← L[i]
            i ← i + 1
        else
            A[k] ← R[j]
            j ← j + 1

BUILD-MAX-HEAP(A, n)
    for i ← n div 2 downto 1 do
        MAX-HEAPIFY(A, i, n)

MAX-HEAPIFY(A, i, n)
    l ← 2 * i
    r ← 2 * i + 1
    largest ← i
    if l ≤ n and A[l] > A[largest] then
        largest ← l
    if r ≤ n and A[r] > A[largest] then
        largest ← r
    if largest ≠ i then
        temp ← A[i]
        A[i] ← A[largest]
        A[largest] ← temp
        MAX-HEAPIFY(A, largest, n)

INSERTION-SORT(A, n)

KNAPSACK-RECURSIVE(W, wt, val, n)

        return 0

        return KNAPSACK-RECURSIVE(W, wt, val, n - 1)
    include ← val[n] + KNAPSACK-RECURSIVE(W - wt[n], wt, val, n - 1)
    exclude ← KNAPSACK-RECURSIVE(W, wt, val, n - 1)
    if include > exclude then
        return include
    else

EDIT-DISTANCE(X, Y, m, n)

            if X[i] = Y[j] then
                D[i][j] ← D[i-1][j-1]
            else

    return D[m][n]

    return r[n]

    return dp[amount]
